board: Sharp GP2Y0E03 distance sensor module (bare Sharp/Socle board with 7-pin 1.25 mm JST cable: VDD, Vout(A), GND, VIN(IO), GPIO1, SCL, SDA)
reason: Modelled from the Sharp GP2Y0E02/03 application note: I2C 0x40, 12-bit distance split over 0x5E[7:0]=D[11:4] and 0x5F[3:0]=D[3:0], cm = raw/16/2^shift (0x35 default 2); GPIO1 driven high, 4.7k pull-ups added, VDD/VIN(IO) on 3.3 V. Part check PASS on esp32 and pico.
